Yavoriv New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Established in the 1840s, this is the newer of Yavoriv's two Jewish cemeteries, serving a community whose presence in the town dates back to 1548 and which received rights to a synagogue and cemetery as early as 1578. The Jewish population fluctuated through the early 20th century before Nazi occupation in June 1941 brought mass deportations and a ghetto that, by its April 1943 liquidation, had seen roughly 3,500 people executed. The cemetery itself is presumed demolished after the war; private houses now stand on what is believed to be its former grounds.
